The Oort Cloud is a distant, spherical shell of icy bodies surrounding the solar system. It is thought to be the source of long-period comets, which have orbital periods of more than 200 years.

The asteroid belt is a region between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter where many asteroids are found. Some asteroids, like Vesta, have orbital periods similar to those of short-period comets.
